MASTER MOTION CALENDAR ON AUG-30-2022 IN 206, PLAINTIFF DOMINADOR CHAVEZ'S MOTION FOR TRIAL PREFERENCE WAS HEARD. APPEARANCES VIA COURTCALL BY CRAIG ASHTON, ESQ. FOR PLAINTIFF DOMINADOR CHAVEZ; CATHERINE SALAH, ESQ. FOR DEFENDANTS BUDGET RENT A CAR SYSTEM, INC., PV HOLDING CORP. AND JAMES MAHONEY; BETH HURLEY, ESQ. FOR CROSS-DEFENDANT DOMINADOR CHAVEZ. THE COURT DID NOT RECEIVE COURTESY COPIES OF PLAINTIFF'S MOVING PAPERS PER LOCAL RULE 2.7(B) AND REQUIRED PLAINTIFF'S COUNSEL TO PAY A $60 MOTION FILING FEE VIA E-FILING IN LIEU OF FILING A NEW MOTION. ARGUED AND THE COURT GRANTED THE MOTION FOR TRIAL PREFERENCE PURSUANT TO CCP SEC 36(E). THE COURT SET THE TRIAL DATE FOR 12/19/22 AT 9:30AM IN DEPT. 206 WITH A LAST DAY OF 12/28/22. COURT WILL PREPARE AN ORDER, TO INCLUDE ALL DISCOVERY DEADLINES/DATES. PARTIES WAIVED NOTICE OF THE NEW TRIAL DATE. (CMC SET FOR 09/28/22 IN DEPT. 610 IS OFF CALENDAR.) JUDGE: SAMUEL K.
